source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Tractor in the Rain
tts_text: On a wet Tuesday in October, a farmer drove his old tractor into Nina's repair shed. "It is impossible to finish today," she said. "The probable problem is the fuel pump, and the only one available is in the city." Her father said patience prevails in a small workshop, so she told him to come on Friday. While he waited, Nina read the contract he had signed with the co-op. She subtracted the price of oil, deducted the cost of two tires, and reduced the total to fit his budget. It took an hour to extract the pump from the engine. A lamp above the bench attracted moths, and the radio distracted her. On the wall hung her father's abstract drawings of machines. Her fingers were stiff, and every movement felt clumsy. Her gloves were not flexible enough, so she used an elastic band and a sheet of plastic. The wet metal reflected the grey sky back at her. "Nothing here is permanent," her father had said, "not even this shed." But the old tractor looked eternal to her: thirty years in the same field, in the same rain. She worked alone: a single pair of hands, the sole worker in the shed. A couple of neighbours stopped by. "You are merely one person," one of them said. "You cannot do double work." But the reward was duple: the money and the farmer's smile. There was something singular in that. On Friday the farmer asked her to evaluate the tractor. She wrote a number on a piece of paper. "It is more valuable repaired than sold," she said.
sentences: On a wet Tuesday in October, a farmer drove his old tractor into Nina's repair shed.
"It is impossible to finish today," she said.
"The probable problem is the fuel pump, and the only one available is in the city."
Her father said patience prevails in a small workshop, so she told him to come on Friday.
While he waited, Nina read the contract he had signed with the co-op.
She subtracted the price of oil, deducted the cost of two tires, and reduced the total to fit his budget.
It took an hour to extract the pump from the engine.
A lamp above the bench attracted moths, and the radio distracted her.
On the wall hung her father's abstract drawings of machines.
Her fingers were stiff, and every movement felt clumsy.
Her gloves were not flexible enough, so she used an elastic band and a sheet of plastic.
The wet metal reflected the grey sky back at her.
"Nothing here is permanent," her father had said, "not even this shed."
But the old tractor looked eternal to her: thirty years in the same field, in the same rain.
She worked alone: a single pair of hands, the sole worker in the shed.
A couple of neighbours stopped by.
"You are merely one person," one of them said.
"You cannot do double work."
But the reward was duple: the money and the farmer's smile.
There was something singular in that.
On Friday the farmer asked her to evaluate the tractor.
She wrote a number on a piece of paper.
"It is more valuable repaired than sold," she said.
sentences_cn: 十月里一个下雨的星期二，一位农民把旧拖拉机开进了妮娜的修理棚。
“今天修不完，”她说。
“最可能出问题的是燃油泵，而唯一能弄到的泵在城里。”
她父亲说过，小铺子里靠的是耐心，于是她让他星期五再来。
他等着的时候，妮娜读了他跟合作社签的那份合同。
她减去油钱，扣掉两条轮胎的费用，再把总价压下来，好配得上他那点预算。
把油泵从发动机里取出来，花了她一个小时。
工作台上方的一盏灯招来了飞蛾，收音机也让她分心。
墙上挂着她父亲画的机器图纸，都是些抽象的东西。
她的手指发僵，每个动作都显得笨拙。
手套不够灵活，她只好用一根松紧带和一张塑料片凑合。
湿漉漉的金属把灰白的天空反射回她脸上。
“这里没有什么是永久的，”她父亲说过，“连这间棚子也不是。”
可那台旧拖拉机在她眼里却是永恒的：在同一个田里、同一场雨里，待了三十年。
她一个人干活：一双手，是棚子里唯一的工人。
几个邻居顺路过来看。
“你只不过是一个人，”其中一个说。
“你干不了双份的活。”
但回报是双重的：钱，还有农民的笑。
这里面有种不同寻常的东西。
星期五，农民请她给这台拖拉机估个价。
她在一张纸上写了个数字。
“修好了比卖掉更值钱，”她说。
